caption:
How to design motions with Claude Opus 5.5

1. Go to Prompt Motion library
2. Find your favorite animation
3. Copy the prompt
4. Switch to Claude
5. Add a note to change the prompt to fit your brand
6. And include your brand assets
7. Adjust effor to Max
8. Opus creates fantastic 15 second brand presentation
9. Perfect for social media or portfolio
